video_title: Luka, Wemby, Tatum and the NBA MVP Race (So Far)

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's MVP case and the Mavericks' team success
quotes.excerpt: If he pull up in a suit, somebody got to get credit where credit is due.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That Croatian motherfucker, there's something wrong. That's one white boy you don't want to see pulling up in a suit. If he pull up in a suit, somebody got to get credit where credit is due. Yes, it is Luka right now. We know.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: But if it wasn't for these goddamn injuries, Anthony Edwards should be and would be in conversation.

quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert says Luka Doncic is the MVP frontrunner right now but believes Anthony Edwards would be in the conversation if not for injuries

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic needs a Finals MVP, not just a regular season MVP
quotes.excerpt: He don't need this MVP, he needs the Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: He don't need this MVP, he needs the Finals MVP. We not worried about cup championships. Even this MVP, you go get you one after you get the Finals MVP. Don't worry about it, I like what you did. Go on and get that knee cleaned up. We get sick of you having to deal with that in the playoffs. Get that cleaned up now.
quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert on Luka Doncic: He does not need a regular season MVP, he needs a Finals MVP. Get that knee cleaned up for the playoffs

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's defensive impact versus Luka Doncic's offensive production
quotes.excerpt: Can Wemby's defense win an MVP over Luka's historic offensive output?

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Can Wemby's defense win an MVP over Luka's historic offensive output? The only way he does is if Luka keeps doing this and the Lakers stop winning. But if the Lakers keep winning at this pace, honestly, Wemby, love you. You'll get DPOY again because it's honestly, I'm not going to say it.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: But what if Wemby has a better, what if they got a way better record?

quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert breaks down the MVP race between Luka Doncic and Victor Wembanyama, noting that Wemby could have a path if the Spurs record improves significantly

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's MVP candidacy despite Thunder injury issues
quotes.excerpt: All them guys went down and I think he has welcomed it.
quotes.quote: All them guys went down and I think he has welcomed it. The Thunder are 8-2, dealing with injuries to Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Jalen Williams and more. But SGA just doesn't seem to care. He definitely doesn't get the credit he deserves, because I told y'all he could hoop. I get the foul merchant talk, but all my favorites shot 13, 14 free throws.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous Alexander does not get the credit he deserves. Iman Shumpert defends SGA against the foul merchant label, noting that all the greats shoot double digit free throws

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's ability to control game pace and defensive reads
quotes.excerpt: He also controls the game pace at will, meaning sometimes you could tell he's not really trying.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Not only does he control the free throw pace, but he also controls the game pace at will, meaning sometimes you could tell he's not really trying as hard as most players do to control this game, but yet he is controlling the fuck out of this game. Defensively and offensively, he's not doing nothing but playing the passing lane, being a good teammate, but he's so good and so inept at reading the defenses, it's kind of tough to deal with.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I think the defensive part of it, that's why the conversation has even been brought up. I think that is propaganda to help deal with the weight of what Luka comes with. You have to consider Luka doesn't play any defense, but this year he's playing defense.

quotes.social_post: Arhii Shumpert on SGA: He controls the game pace at will and is elite at reading defenses, making him a legitimate MVP candidate

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's MVP-level performance for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is definitely in the conversation. He is busting ass this year.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is definitely in the conversation. He is busting ass this year. Bullshitted the other night on his birthday though. He bullshitted. He was drinking. He was drinking the night before, he had a little too much. He had a little too much fun on his birthday, but other than that though, he's been going crazy.
quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert says Tyrese Maxey is playing at an MVP level this year, despite a rough performance after having a little too much fun on his birthday

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's MVP chances and leadership role
quotes.excerpt: I don't think right now he's in striking range for MVP.
quotes.quote: I don't think right now he's in striking range for MVP. He better be happy that Anthony Edwards has nothing to say at the moment. And they also better be happy that Jokic has started the season somewhere else. If anybody has seen Jokic, go call him. He's there, he's in Denver. We know that.
quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert does not think Jayson Tatum is currently in striking range for the MVP award

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert's observation of Nikola Jokic's fatigue
quotes.excerpt: I watched him play a game where he looked tired.
quotes.quote: The reason I say they cloned him is because I watched him play a game where he looked tired. Like I don't want to be here tired or like I'm going to try and run the timeout. I'm about to run the timeout. It was like he just wanted to win by one. And I was looking like, what the fuck are you doing? You're in single coverage on the pinch post.
quotes.social_post: Iman Shumpert on Nikola Jokic: I watched him play a game where he looked tired, like he just wanted to win by one and get out of there
